A newline inside two nested spans after an emphasis still separates the words on either side

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<p><i>Alpha</i><span><span>\n</span></span>Beta</p>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
```
